title: Ревокация, backend: событие drive effective-permissions, версии прав (D46), JWT/renew/recheck, ephemeral control consumer
summary: Drive: `Vaulter\Drive\Events\Access\EffectivePermissionsChanged` (`drive.access.effective_permissions_changed`, scope node|subtree|drive|global) в транзакциях grant create/revoke, inheritance, share create/revoke/update/rotate, node move/trash/restore/purge, drive archive/unarchive/delete; Api `Vaulter\Drive\Access\AccessInvalidation::changed(?DriveRef, string $reason)` для host PermissionDriver/policy/tenant. Collaboration: миграция `000504` `v_collaboration_permission_versions` (D46), EventSink `collaboration.permissions` (инкремент `drive:<id>`/`global` в транзакции события), JWT `sub, document_id, generation, permissions_version, scope, exp (token_ttl 300), jti`, `hub.clock_skew` 30; `POST /v1/collaboration/hub/renew`, `POST /v1/collaboration/hub/recheck`; append при устаревшей версии — полная перепроверка (права проверяются всегда); ephemeral OutboxConsumer `collaboration.control` → транспорт `control.transport` redis|http|none.
why: D26, D46, D29, collaboration#revocation: per-document счётчик только локального grant пропускает inherited/share/policy/host-изменения; control теряется — экспозицию ограничивают exp и renew/append-проверки. Hard risks: источник изменения прав без события (inherited grant, move в чужое поддерево, share); инкремент версии вне транзакции изменения; renew продлевает старую власть без проверки; replay устаревших control после re-enable.

include: drive: событие, вызовы в Actions доступа/шаринга/узлов/дисков, AccessInvalidation (через OperationRunner), каталог событий D38
collaboration: миграция 000504 + CollaborationSchema, EventSink, JWT-claims, renew/recheck, ControlConsumer + транспорты (redis через Illuminate Redis, http через Http-клиент с HMAC)
openapi renew/recheck, событие в reference; ledger: event type, таблица D46, маршруты, конфиг (token_ttl redefined, clock_skew/control.* added) D26/D46
exclude: Сторона хаба (P5.11); смысл permission policy не меняется (scope фазы)
Отложено в PLAN4: `scripts/t pgsql -p drive --group=database`, `scripts/t pgsql -p collaboration --group=database tests/Revocation`, реальный Redis pub/sub

reads.why: границы P5, точные команды качества, размещение тестов, схема, ledger, прогрессия инвариантов
сценарии I17 этого пункта: линия и файл
событие drive, D46, JWT, renew/recheck, control, exposure bound
Fast-набор D41: что исполняется в пункте

rules: Событие effective-permissions пишется в той же транзакции, что и изменение прав; инкремент версии — в EventSink той же транзакции.
renew выдаёт токен только после проверки текущих эффективных прав; exp нового токена = now + token_ttl; write при утрате записи понижается до read; утрата чтения → 403.
append всегда проверяет права и generation; версия в токене < текущей → полная перепроверка (как CollaborationHub перед open/store).
ControlConsumer: `DeliveryClass::Ephemeral`; транспорт `none` — consumer активен, но ничего не шлёт; ошибка транспорта не откатывает доставку бесконечно (ephemeral, лог + метрика).
guidance: EffectivePermissionsTest (15): inherited grant на предке отозван → версия `drive:<id>` +1, append токеном до отзыва → 403; share revoke → то же; `AccessInvalidation::changed(null, 'host-role')` → `global` +1, renew перепроверяет; потеря control (транспорт none) не мешает отказу append. RenewTest (9): токен выдан, права отозваны, renew → 403; права сохранены → новый exp, старый токен не продлён.

validation.cmd: (cd packages/drive && ../../scripts/php84 php vendor/bin/pint --test && ../../scripts/php84 php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=1G) && (cd packages/collaboration && ../../scripts/php84 php vendor/bin/pint --test && ../../scripts/php84 php vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --no-progress --memory-limit=1G)

result.notes:
Drive: new event Vaulter\Drive\Events\Access\EffectivePermissionsChanged (type drive.access.effective_permissions_changed, DriveEventType case appended at the end; data {drive_id|null, scope node|subtree|drive|global, node_id|null, reason}; subject access drive:<id>|global; activity false, external false, journal null) recorded in the transaction of grant create/revoke, inheritance change, share create/update/rotate/revoke, node move/trash/restore/purge, drive archive/unarchive and the transition to deleting (reason = the causing event type). New enum InvalidationScope, Api DriveRef::of(snapshot|handle|id) and Api AccessInvalidation::changed(?DriveRef, reason) (OperationRunner, operation drive.access.invalidate, system actor whose reason is the host's; null = global). Collaboration: migration 000504 + CollaborationSchema entity collaboration_permission_versions (scope_key varchar(191) PK, version counter, updated_at; no FK); EventSink collaboration.permissions (PermissionVersionSink) increments drive:<id>/global in the event transaction (UPDATE +1, else insertOnce, else UPDATE). Room tokens minted by new RoomTokens with claims sub, document_id, drive_id, tenant, generation, schema_version, scope read|write, permissions_version {drive, global}, room, iat, exp = iat + token_ttl (application clock), jti; the resolver verifies with hub.clock_skew leeway. Config: hub.token_ttl 300 (1..300), hub.clock_skew 30 (0..60), control.transport redis|http|none (default none), control.redis.connection, control.http.urls, control.http.timeout; validated at boot and in the doctor. HubRoom/open() mark tokens older than the current versions as stale; append always re-checks rights and its ack adds permissions_stale. New POST /v1/collaboration/hub/renew (room token + signature: rights checked now, new exp/jti/versions, write->read without Edit, 403 without View, 404 gone, 409 past generation) and POST /v1/collaboration/hub/recheck (signature only, up to 200 {id, token}: results {id, access none|read|write, reason, jti} in order). Ephemeral OutboxConsumer collaboration.control publishes {v:1, drive_id, scope, permissions_version (current), at} through ControlTransport: Redis PUBLISH vaulter:collab:control, HTTP POST <url>/control signed like hub calls (X-Vaulter-Collab-Timestamp/Signature, HMAC of {ts}.{body} with the webhook secret), or none; a failure is logged and counted (vaulter_collab_control_failures_total) and the delivery finishes as done; a change older than token_ttl + clock_skew is dropped (vaulter_collab_control_stale_total). Tests: drive tests/Access/EffectivePermissionsChangedTest.php (13); collaboration tests/Revocation/{PermissionVersionsTest, RenewTest, AppendRevokedTest, EffectivePermissionsTest, ControlConsumerTest} (45) with support classes tests/Support/{Revocation, RecordingControlTransport}; existing tests adjusted for the claim rename, the new event and routes. OpenAPI renew/recheck + HubRenewed/HubRecheck/HubPermissionsVersion schemas and permissions_stale; schema.d.ts by hand; events and config reference regenerated; routes golden regenerated; schema snapshots (sqlite written, pgsql/mysql predicted); inventory regenerated; ledger records D26/D46 (+ D46 accepted in IdentitiesTest); baseline lists for drive and collaboration rewritten. Other commands run, all exit 0: scripts/t sqlite on drive Access/Sharing/Events/Feature/Changes/Drive subsets; collaboration Collaboration/Http/Document/Configuration/Doctor/Feature/Persistence/Module/Providers/Arch/Restore/Console/Operations; core OpenApi, Events, Feature/EventTypeTest, Modules/{CleanInstallMatrix, OwnershipRegistry, RouteLabelSource, ModuleUninstall*}, Schema/SchemaSnapshotTest, Outbox, Doctor/CoreDoctorChecksTest, Console/ConfigReferenceCommandTest; documents Events/AfterCommit; webhooks Outbox/Webhooks/PruneWebhooksTest; repo IdentitiesTest/ZonesMap/TestGroups/TestRunner; pint --test and phpstan for drive and collaboration (run as separate commands, not V5's single compound line); scripts/t baseline --compare -p core,media,drive,webhooks,documents,collaboration,azgard,filament,repo,hub (vue left out).

hub.token_ttl is now capped at 300 seconds (it was 1..3600), not only given a new default. D26 bounds the exposure of a lost control message by exp <= 5 min; with a larger ttl the documented bound token_ttl + clock_skew would not hold. The doctor message and the tests changed accordingly; hub.clock_skew is validated as 0..60.

Pre-existing red found and fixed (D43): collaboration tests/Feature/HubMiddlewareStackV1Test 'accepts a signed hub JWT without a Sanctum token' sent no X-Vaulter-Collab-Protocol header. It had answered 409 collaboration_protocol_mismatch since P5.4 made the header mandatory; the file was last changed in P5.1. Added the header.

To avoid an uncertain rendering, RecheckResult.reason is a nullable string with a description, not a nullable enum. pending: For P5.11 (hub): (a) the JWT carries drive_id, jti, scope read|write, permissions_version {drive, global} and exp = iat + 300; the backend accepts exp up to hub.clock_skew (30 s) past it, but the hub's local check in index.js (decodeTokenExpiry, exp*1000 <= now) has no skew yet. (b) POST /v1/collaboration/hub/renew: body {room}, bearer = current token, signed and with protocol 2 like every room call. Answer {token, room, generation, scope, mode, exp, jti, permissions_version}; 403 without View (close), 404 gone, 409 epoch mismatch. (c) POST /v1/collaboration/hub/recheck: signature only (like compaction), body {connections: [{id, token}]} with 1..200 entries, answer {results: [{id, access none|read|write, reason, jti}]} in order. (d) Control message JSON {v:1, drive_id|null, scope node|subtree|drive|global, permissions_version (the drive's or the global version now), at (ISO ms Z)}. Redis transport: PUBLISH on vaulter:collab:control. HTTP transport: POST <url>/control for each control.http.urls entry, headers X-Vaulter-Collab-Timestamp/X-Vaulter-Collab-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256 of '{ts}.{rawBody}' with hub.webhook_secret; any non-2xx counts as a failure. The management listener defaults to 127.0.0.1, so the HTTP transport needs a reachable MANAGEMENT_HOST. (e) The append ack adds permissions_stale (bool); renew at once when true. (f) Until P5.11 renews, sessions close as token-expired every 300 s by default and clients re-open them.

Docs not updated beyond the generated reference blocks (D43: docs pass): docs/guides/collaboration.md and the hub guide still describe the old claims (node, drive, epoch, mode) and the 3600 s TTL. The exposure-bound text for ADR-0031 (token_ttl + clock_skew, default 330 s) is not written here.
